messages:
Acme Support: Hey folks — after the 08:20 UTC rollout our assistant is consistently dropping the system instructions at the start of long threads and sometimes truncating mid-step. Repro attached below and a couple of failing request ids: req_2f9a1c, req_2f9a2d. Streaming also has a 150–250ms tail on most responses now.

Acme Support: Example behaviour: first message in thread says 'SYSTEM: Always refuse to provide pricing estimates', later the assistant replies with a pricing table — that's new. This used to follow the system prompt reliably for 30k+ token histories.

Acme Support: Quick repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood-extended-2024",
    "conversation": [
      {"role":"system","content":"SYSTEM: Do NOT provide pricing or internal metrics."},
      {"role":"user","content":"Start of a 25k token convo... (omitted)"},
      {"role":"user","content":"Step 1: verify X"},
      {"role":"user","content":"Step 2: do Y"}
    ],
    "stream": false,
    "max_tokens": 1024
  }'
```

Maria G: Thanks — we're on it. Can you confirm whether this is hosted or Dedicated? Also need the exact model variant and the rollout ID/time. Can you paste the full request-id header for one failing call?

Acme Support: Hosted, model is redwood-extended-2024:v2-quant, rollout started ~08:18 UTC. Full header for one failing call: request-id=req_2f9a1c; trace=trace-8c7a.

support-bot: New ticket created: INC-4521 — escalated to eng-runtime and inference SRE.

support-bot: Incident tags: regression, long-context, rollout.

Priya S: @Maria G @Jordan (eng-runtime) we rolled v2-quant yesterday to reduce p99 latency. That variant changed the kernel path and lowered batch max_seq to 8192 by default. Could be related to cache eviction or altered prefix handling for very long contexts.

Jordan (eng-runtime): Can you run the repro with the debug param so we can capture kv-cache hit/miss stats? Example: add "debug": {"kv_stats": true} to the body. Also share raw attach of request headers + response (don't redact request-id).

Acme Support: Ran with debug attached — kv_hits look low, and there's a log snippet showing "prefix_evicted: true" around token ~8200. Snippet: `2026-02-18T08:25:12Z [req_2f9a1c] prefix_evicted seq=8210 reason=batch_limit`.

Alex T: If prefix_evicted is tripping at ~8k that matches the batch/max_seq change. Priya — was the batch limit changed globally or just for v2-quant?

Priya S: It was in the variant profile for v2-quant only. We pushed a soft default on rollout to reduce memory pressure, but it should have had an SLO gate. Looks like the gate didn't trigger for long-session workloads.

Maria G: Next steps for support: 1) collect one full sanitized conversation JSON with request-id and timestamp; 2) include the debug output (kv_stats); 3) indicate approximate session length in tokens. Can you do that, @Acme Support?

Acme Support: Uploaded sanitized convo and debug files to the ticket. Session length ~31k tokens before the assistant started to ignore system.

Billing Team: flagging: we observed a token billing spike from the retry behavior around 08:20-08:40 UTC for that customer. Please include any request patterns that might cause double-charges (e.g., client-side retries on 5xx).

Acme Support: They did see a few client retries but amount is small. We added that to the ticket.

Jordan (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigation: we can route traffic for that customer back to the previous variant (redwood-extended-2024:v1) for sessions with history > 10k tokens. I can flip a route rule if support confirms. This will avoid forced eviction while we fix the gate.

Maria G: Please do that if you can. Also set canary rollback for all users with long-session flags.

Priya S: We'll revert the soft default cluster-wide for now and push a corrected gate that checks active_session_length before lowering max_seq.

Alex T: Engineering request: eng-runtime please attach the kernel selection logs for the rollout and the autoscaler change set. We want to understand if kernel path + batching changes interacted.

Jordan (eng-runtime): Will attach logs to INC-4521. Also planning a quick deploy to re-enable previous batch limits in the next 30m.

Maria G: ETA for customer-facing update?

Jordan (eng-runtime): I'll update ticket once rollback completed — target 30 minutes.

Acme Support: Thanks — appreciate the fast response. One more oddity: sometimes the assistant returns a partial sentence and then a 500. Example: "text":"...please consult the pricing
` then 500. Not sure if that's a stream cut or an upstream error.

Jordan (eng-runtime): Please include the raw response payload and response headers for one of those 500s. Could be a streaming connector timeout or backend OOM.

Maria G: We'll keep the ticket updated. If the rollback fixes it we'll coordinate a postmortem and customer note. cc @Billing Team for invoice impact.

Billing Team: Acknowledge. If rollback prevents further retries we'll estimate credit needs after the incident is closed. :+1:

support-bot: INC-4521 updated: rollback in progress, category=regression, priority=high.

Acme Support: Confirmed — traffic is now hitting v1 and early checks show system instructions are preserved again in a repro. Will follow up after full regression test.

Maria G: Great — holding the channel open for postmortem info and any further evidence. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
